facts.fact: Lucy 从 Saskia 内眼角拔出一株带一片极小叶子的小苗，却想不通它怎么长进去的
facts.anchor: just plucked a plant seedling from the corner of Saskia’s eye

facts.fact: Lucy 上周在 Buzzfeed 读到：男子因疑似肺癌开刀，医生反而在他肺里发现一棵小冷杉
facts.anchor: they instead found a tiny fir tree

facts.fact: 那棵肺里的小冷杉被形容为「两英寸的生命」，在人体肺里悄悄发芽
facts.anchor: Two inches of life, quietly germinating in a human lung

facts.fact: 拥抱时 Saskia 与 Lucy 身高相差六英寸，Saskia 双手在 Lucy 背后合拢
facts.anchor: separated by six inches in height

facts.fact: Lucy 追问那是什么种子，Saskia 起先不答，只丢下「不确定，回头见」就端汤上楼
facts.anchor: but then she says, “Not sure. See you later!”

facts.fact: Lucy 骑车去店里买回一个橡皮门挡（怕装真五金件惹 Roger 发火），试过后卡在门下
facts.anchor: having selected a rubber doorstop since she’s fairly certain

facts.fact: Lucy 就着吐司把汤吃掉，说她再也不想闻到玉米面包的气味
facts.anchor: with toast, as she will never want to smell cornbread again

facts.fact: 章末落点（本章 POV＝Lucy）：深夜她被惊醒，客厅里一个男人的声音吼道「No! You bitch!」
